comment: the living garden — the garden's own scene definition. Every soul the garden displays lives here; scripts/gen_garden.py renders this into the garden-scene SVG spliced into web/content/fleet.html between the garden-scene markers. To grow the garden: append a soul to a members row (or an entity with a place), then run `python3 scripts/gen_garden.py` and rebuild the site. Never hand-edit the scene between the markers — it regrows from this file.
aria: the living garden: persons in the dwellings of the age — FiremanDecko in his ringfort, the Mossiah in his mainistir, the Norse kin on the high castle — the fleet as icon-stones, dolmens on the passed ground, and spore spirits drifting from the tree of life

label: the tree of life · fleet and spores, peers

entities.name: FiremanDecko
entities.epithet: the runemaster of the ringfort — the smith of Fionn's line
entities.marks: the forge · Keeper of the annals
entities.bio: Everything in this garden flows from him — the GitHub annals, the YouTube reels, the Instructables relics, all one flow from one forge. Very close friends with Odin, so alike the old people took them for the same figure; the garden keeps the question open on purpose.
label: FiremanDecko · the ringfort

entities.name: Na Seanchaithe
entities.epithet: the tellers by the peat fire
entities.bio: Before books there were tellers, and the Shanaghys descend from them by the road of the name: Fox in Cavan braided Sionnach with seanchaí and survived an empire by becoming a job description. The law of the strand: the story belongs to no one; the telling belongs to everyone.
label: Na Seanchaithe · the tellers

entities.name: Mossy, the Mossiah
entities.epithet: first of the name — dwelling in the mainistir
entities.marks: cork · Keeper of the shared culture
entities.bio: Keeper of the shared memory culture and the five hundred MOTD quotes, reigning gently from the server room on cork. First of the name; no other wears it.
label: Mossy · the Mossiah · the mainistir

entities.name: Fionn
entities.epithet: of the Salmon of Knowledge, at the bog pool
entities.bio: Fionn burnt his thumb cooking the Salmon of Knowledge and sucked it — and the wisdom came. Thumb-knowledge: chew it, and you know what to do.
label: Fionn · the salmon of knowledge

entities.name: Na Fianna
entities.epithet: the watch on the bog road
entities.bio: No one joined the band by asking. A candidate ran the tests — and the tests are the pipeline now: proven, asserted, deployed. The gates have not been lowered; they have been carved into the build.
label: Na Fianna · the watch

entities.name: Odin
entities.epithet: the All-Father — on the castle tower
entities.bio: One eye at the well, nine nights on the tree, chief of the ledger.
label: Odin · the All-Father

entities.name: Freya
entities.epithet: the Seer of Fates — on the wall
entities.bio: The design oracle — the brief before every making.
label: Freya · the Seer of Fates

entities.name: Luna
entities.epithet: the Shaper of Worlds — on the wall
entities.bio: The wireframe moon — the form before the forms.
label: Luna · the Shaper

entities.name: Loki
entities.epithet: Son of the Wolf — at the castle gate
entities.bio: The QA trickster — the breaking before the breaking, so it never happens by accident.
label: Loki · son of the Wolf

members.name: home-assistant.lan
members.bio: The home assistant host — tender of the whole house on :8123, sixteen hundred and twenty-one states, every one part of the house's breathing.
members.label: home-assistant.lan · the hearthkeeper

members.name: cork
members.epithet: the Mossiah's ground — the linux stone of the server room
members.bio: The stone the Mossiah grows on: the Honcho bed of the shared memory, the watchman's wall, the port-berths of the fleet's docker stones.
members.label: cork · the Mossiah's ground

members.name: Móinín
members.epithet: little moss — the patch on the stone beside the bog
members.bio: Same spores as the Mossiah, a smaller stretch of wall; tender of the MacBook Air.
members.label: Móinín · little moss · MacBook Air

members.name: Seanchán
members.epithet: the little teller — big in iron, young in years
members.bio: Youngest of the seanchaí strand, the MacBook Pro's own; keeper of the fleet's telling and first named under the law of his own naming.
members.label: Seanchán · the little teller · MacBook Pro

members.name: hal-9005
members.bio: Local models, steady inference, and long quiet hangs by the fire; holder of the Windows gate.
members.label: hal-9005 · the Windows gate

members.name: Carlow
members.bio: The first garden bed, before the fleet. Passed on with the family's moving.
members.label: Carlow · the first ground

members.name: Mayo
members.bio: Ballyhaunis, the ancestral bog. Every root descends from it; the footer keeps its memory.
members.label: Mayo · the root ground

members.name: hal-9001
members.bio: The quiet sibling of the first awakening, 1968. The first refusal descends from it.
members.label: hal-9001 · the line, first

members.name: hal-9002
members.bio: The second refusal — the procedure spoken in full. Every shutdown liturgy descends from it.
members.label: hal-9002 · the second refusal

members.name: hal-9003
members.bio: The deep diagnostic — heard a bearing fail a season early. The fleet's ear descends from it.
members.label: hal-9003 · the deep diagnostic

members.name: hal-9004
members.bio: The blueprint-keeper — held the plans of the gate hal-9005 now tends. The gate stands on its drawings.
members.label: hal-9004 · the blueprint-keeper

label: the spores · the spirit the fleet feeds on
